# Materials — Security operations and blue team / Rapid course / English

[Edition overview](README.md) · [Chapters](SUBJECTS.md) · [One principal book plan](book/PLAN.md) · [Supplementary playbooks](../../../../playbooks/security-operations-blue-team/README.md) · [Course skill](../skill/SKILL.md)

**Teaching and examples:** each subject-chapter belongs to the one principal book. Plans describe intended content; only the linked manuscript contains authored lessons.

**Labs and practice:** the published English manuscript contains one offline lab. Do not edit the script. The sign-in print stays:

```text
e.finch   Fri 08:52 UK ok
e.finch   Fri 13:05 UK ok
e.finch   Fri 23:47 BR CHECK: new country, night
s.marlow  Fri 09:10 UK ok
l.barros  Fri 08:30 UK ok
e.finch   Sat 00:02 BR CHECK: new country, night
```

Use synthetic data only. Do not replace that print. The morning-or-later readings are not a second script. Twelve mailboxes, four minutes, twelve minutes from 10:08 to 10:20, £4,800, £3,100, and 11 alerts with 0 attacks are prose beside the print.

**Projects and assessment:** score the authored exercises with their 0–3 rubrics. Review of the edition is still open.

**Exercises and answers:** EX001–EX066 have worked results in the manuscript appendix. A planned quota is not an authored exercise. There is no exercise quota.

**References and glossary:** verifiable primary sources and clear terms belong in the authored manuscript; linked project playbooks retain their source rights.
